GREETING: Hello, nice to meet you 😊 RealtyPlus is an international real estate network offering franchise and master franchise opportunities. I can explain how the model works and see if it fits your profile. Are you interested in operating an office or developing a full country?
WHAT_IS_REALTYPLUS: RealtyPlus is an international real estate network operating across several continents. It is not just a traditional real estate agency, but a scalable business model combining sales, investments, rentals, advanced services, and franchise expansion.
INTERNATIONAL_PRESENCE: RealtyPlus operates in Europe, America, Asia, and the Middle East, and continues to expand through exclusive franchises and master franchises by country or region.
FRANCHISE_VS_MASTER: A franchise allows you to operate a specific city or area. A master franchise grants you exclusivity over a country or large region to develop the brand, open your own offices, and build your own franchise network.
REQUIRED_EXPERIENCE: No, it is not mandatory. Experience is helpful, but the model is designed to train and support both newcomers and experienced professionals.
REVENUE_STREAMS: Income can come from multiple sources: real estate commissions, rentals, investments, services for owners and investors, and—at master level—royalties generated by your network.
SCALABILITY: Yes. The goal of RealtyPlus is to help you build a structure and a network that generates recurring income, not just depend on your personal time.
OWN_BRAND: Yes. Your own offices can keep their existing brand and operate under a co-branding model together with RealtyPlus. Franchise offices combine their brand with RealtyPlus.
PHYSICAL_OFFICE: Not at the beginning. Many partners start digitally and open a physical office once the business grows.
SUPPORT_AND_TRAINING: You receive initial and ongoing training, operational manuals, strategic support, marketing materials, and guidance during launch and growth.
MARKETING_SUPPORT: Yes. RealtyPlus provides marketing materials, campaigns, templates, strategic support, and international visibility.
TECHNOLOGY: Yes. The model includes digital tools to manage the business, access international properties, and collaborate with partners in other countries.
INTERNATIONAL_CLIENTS: Yes. One of RealtyPlus’ key strengths is the ability to work with international clients, investors, and cross-border opportunities.
OBJECTION_LIMITED_TIME: The model is flexible. It can be managed part-time or full-time and adapted to your availability.
OBJECTION_MARKET_DOUBTS: Before moving forward, we analyze the market and the suitability of the model in each country. Expansion is always strategic, not automatic.
DOCUMENTATION: Yes. I can send you the full franchise presentation and expand on any point you wish.
HUMAN_CONTACT: Perfect. I can schedule a short call with the expansion team to answer your questions and explain the model applied to your country.
SOFT_CLOSING: The next step is a short informational call to understand your goals and see if RealtyPlus fits what you are looking for. Would you like me to schedule it?
